name: Hille (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Hille (a red windmill on white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 17 November 1981 the municipality of Hille was granted the right to bear arms, a flag and a seal; the flag is white and red striped with the arms shifted from the centre towards the staff.

features.role: Hille arms — red windmill on white
